# Schilly’s Take Out & Catering Kitchen

> Smoked. Homemade. Maine. Take Out • Family Meals • Catering.

Take out, family meals and catering in Casco, Maine. Smoked brisket, pulled pork and pulled chicken with homemade sides, Wednesday – Sunday.

- Location: 224 Roosevelt Trail, Casco, ME 04015
- Business Hours: Wednesday – Sunday, 11 am – 6 pm
- Store Phone #: (207) 693-8840
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/schillyseats
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1DnxQNy3wD/

## Pages
- [Take Out Kitchen Menu](https://schillyscatering.com/take-out-menu/): BBQ Plates, White Cheddar Mac & Cheese, Family Size Portions, Sandwiches, Specialty Items, Specialty Beef Hot Dogs, Sides, Dessert. Prices include Maine State Sales Tax.
- [Catering Menu](https://schillyscatering.com/catering-menu/): Boxed Lunch, Elevated Boxed Lunches, Boxed Salads, Soups & Crock Favorites, Desserts, Party Platters, Boards & Grazes.
- [Weddings](https://schillyscatering.com/weddings/)
- [Lobster Bakes](https://schillyscatering.com/lobster-bakes/)
- [Pig Roasts](https://schillyscatering.com/pig-roasts/)
- [Catering Inquiries](https://schillyscatering.com/catering-inquiries/)
